name: Coastal Path
theme: A warm coastal walk past cliffs, lighthouses, tide pools and hidden coves, from a quiet beach gate to a lantern-lit harbor.

milestones.name: Driftwood Gate
milestones.loreText: The path begins where the sand gives way to grass. Someone has hung a bell on the old gate, and it rings softly as you pass.

milestones.name: Gull Rock
milestones.loreText: A hundred gulls argue over the best ledge, and none of them mind you. The wind smells of salt and warm bread from somewhere inland.

milestones.name: Tide Pool Terrace
milestones.loreText: The sea has stepped back and left small bright worlds in the rocks. Crouch down and see who is home.

milestones.name: Lantern Point
milestones.loreText: A little white lighthouse keeps watch over the bay. The keeper leaves a thermos of something warm on the step for travelers.

milestones.name: Halfway Cove
milestones.loreText: You have come a long way, and the water looks very inviting.

milestones.name: Smugglers' Steps
milestones.loreText: Worn stone stairs drop toward a cave mouth, and the stories about them get bolder every year. Nobody remembers who carved them.

milestones.name: Whispering Cliffs
milestones.loreText: The wind plays the cliff face like a flute here. Stand still a moment and listen.

milestones.name: Kelp Garden Bay
milestones.loreText: Golden kelp sways under clear green water, and seals drift lazily between the ribbons. The path runs close enough to wave.

milestones.name: Sunset Headland
milestones.loreText: The last high point of the trail, and the sky puts on its best colors for it. The harbor lights are just coming into view.

milestones.name: Harbor of Lanterns
milestones.loreText: Boats bob in the dark water and every window along the quay glows. Someone has saved you a seat by the fire.

completedText: You walked the whole Coastal Path, from the first bell to the last lantern, one step at a time.
